description: Deep level ratio signal: bid-side vs ask-side deep liquidity layering (levels 3-5 / levels 1-5) in early market snapshots. Best config: window=2000ms, threshold=0.3, spread_pct>=75. 2s window (0.529) outperforms 5s (0.513) on win rate — SUPPORTED.
hypothesis: Restrict deep_level_ratio signal to first 2s after market open and only trade markets with spread > 0.05. Earliest snapshots capture initial MM positioning before arbitrageurs flatten the book. Wide-spread markets amplify informational content of deep liquidity placement.
next_steps: Test on full dataset (7187 markets) to confirm. Explore combining deep_level_ratio with book_imbalance for stronger signal.
